name: Kavy Sharma
tagline: Cybersecurity | VAPT | Web Application & AI Security
summary: Final-year Electronics & Computer Engineering student. Tested web applications and networks for 20+ client environments as a VAPT intern, and built tools for phishing simulation, LLM-agent security and intrusion detection. Looking for an internship in VAPT or AI security.

highlights: Performed web application and network VAPT for 20+ client environments across finance, startups, and other sectors using Burp Suite, Nmap, Nessus, and Kali Linux.
Identified SQL injection, XSS, access-control weaknesses, and firewall misconfigurations through reconnaissance, enumeration, and validation.
Reported findings with evidence, risk ratings, and remediation guidance, and presented them to clients.
Built MATLAB UAV flight-path simulations with monitoring logic that flags routes entering restricted zones.

projects.name: PhishSim AI
projects.tech: Python, Flask, MySQL, LLM APIs, OSINT
highlights: Built and deployed a phishing-simulation platform with CSV employee import, role-aware AI email generation, configurable SMTP, and live open, click, and report tracking.
Developed PhishRecon for lookalike-domain, SPF/DMARC, RDAP, TLS, and subdomain checks, plus email-header, phishing-URL, and password-breach analysis.
Added AI-assisted risk dashboards and PDF reports; tested SSRF, CSRF, and access-control protections.

projects.name: AegisAgent
highlights: Built a nine-stage security gateway between a local LLM agent and its tools/devices: prompt-injection detection, intent checks, RBAC, rate limiting, human approval, and output scanning.
Added MQTT/ESP32 bridging and hash-chained audit logs; test suite has 399 automated tests.

projects.name: SentinelFlow
highlights: Built an offline network intrusion detection system combining rules (port scans, SYN/UDP floods, SSH brute force, ARP spoofing) with Isolation Forest anomaly detection.
Added MITRE ATT&CK mapping, a triage dashboard, and report exports; includes 40 automated tests.

projects.name: SafeLine WAF + DVWA Home Lab
highlights: Deployed DVWA behind SafeLine WAF/reverse proxy with local DNS and HTTPS; verified routing and responses.
